title: European musicians try to copy the band
summary: At the Fawn des Westen in Berlin a German band attempts improvisation and the master of ceremonies tells the audience to applaud them.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, tell me about the different places you went to in Europe. The musicians. You said before the musicians came up to you and were curious. They'd never heard improvisation and they didn't know some of the sounds you made with the mutes and so forth.
Yeah, that was the beginning of the --
Were they -- did they try to emulate you. Did they --

We had a band, after, when we come out of Russia, we went to a place called Fawn Des Westen in Berlin. And again we played and there was a German band on the stand, so that they had an idea that we might do something like this, too. Their improvisation was like cacophony. And they were mixed up. But they tried it; but what happened, this whatcha call, M.C., or what we'd call Master of Ceremonies, I'll never forget what he said. He said, but he said to the Germans, and I don't know what he said, all of it, but we only could understand some places. But it ended up with, 'Deutsches trink Deutsches bier.'
